name: Melbourne Mini Saturday 2022
information:
This is a series competition alonside [Melbourne Mini Sunday 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MelbourneMiniSunday2022) and [Melbourne Mental Mania 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MelbourneMentalMania2022). You will be permitted to compete at ONLY ONE of the three competitions. If you register for both, your registration will only be accepted for one of the competitions. Please note that each competition has a different set of events.

There is a strict limit of ONE GUEST PER COMPETITOR.
